page_title: Rajendra P N - Senior DevOps / SRE Engineer
headline: Senior Site Reliability Engineer | Jenkins | Production Operations
summary_html: Senior DevOps / Site Reliability Engineer with 10+ years of experience in enterprise application delivery and production operations. Specializes in Jenkins CI/CD, application observability, on-call support, incident management, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis. Builds reusable pipelines and operational tooling with Groovy, Python, Bash, and PowerShell; investigates application and infrastructure failures across Linux, containers, and Azure/AWS environments. Partners with developers and infrastructure teams to improve release readiness, reduce recurring operational work, and maintain reliable services.

achievements.text: Standardized Jenkinsfiles, shared libraries, build agents, test gates, and artifact promotion for repeatable application deployments.
Correlated application logs and platform metrics during incidents; maintained actionable alerts, recovery procedures, and root cause follow-up.
Developed Python integrations and scripting utilities for onboarding, deployment checks, diagnostics, and recurring support tasks.
